evidence.exact_span: In Construction, Forestry, Mining & Energy Union v Coal & Allied Operations Pty Ltd (No 2) [1999] FCA 1714 ; (1999) 94 IR 231 at 232 Branson J listed a number of matters that are relevant to penalty in relation to contraventions under Pt XA of the WR Act. One matter her Honour considered was whether the respondent had previously been found to have engaged in conduct in contravention of Pt XA of that Act.
